formula.name: Iris Impériale — Powdery Iris / Suede
formula.body:
**Commercial Reference:** Dior Homme Intense × Roja Enigma  
**Wearing Impression:** A sculptural iris wrapped in buttery suede and warm cashmere. Opens with a flash of bergamot and cardamom spice before revealing a deep orris-violet heart over a bed of sandalwood and clean amber. The kind of fragrance that makes people lean closer.  
**Concentration:** 25% in ethanol  
**Luxury Rating:** ★★★★★ — Six luxury differentiators anchored by a generous Alpha Irone dose; Javanol and Ambrox Super provide the skin-scent intimacy of a true Extrait.

| # | Ingredient | Dilution | Amount (µL) | Amount (mL) |
|---|-----------|----------|------------|------------|
| 1 | Bergamot FCF Sicilian | neat | 120 | 0.12 |
| 2 | Cardamom FTEC | 10% | 80 | 0.08 |
| 3 | Aldehyde C11 | 1% | 50 | 0.05 |
| 4 | Alpha Irone | 10% | 450 | 0.45 |
| 5 | Orivone | neat | 80 | 0.08 |
| 6 | Methyl Ionone | neat | 120 | 0.12 |
| 7 | Hedione | neat | 200 | 0.20 |
| 8 | Suederal | 10% | 100 | 0.10 |
| 9 | Javanol | neat | 150 | 0.15 |
| 10 | Cashmeran | 20% | 200 | 0.20 |
| 11 | Ambrox Super | 30% | 200 | 0.20 |
| 12 | Habanolide | neat | 100 | 0.10 |
| 13 | Iso E Super | neat | 300 | 0.30 |
| 14 | Benzyl Salicylate | neat | 100 | 0.10 |
| 15 | Vanillin | 10% | 100 | 0.10 |
| 16 | Coumarin | 20% | 150 | 0.15 |
| 17 | **Ethanol 96%** | — | — | **7.50** |
| | **TOTAL** | | | **10.00** |

**Concentrate total:** 2.50 mL (25.0%)

---

  Seal tightly and store in a cool, dark place.
  Estimated maturation: 17 days minimum.

  Best results typically at day 17 – 31.
